chunks: Say: 'The reward I ask is for yourself. My reward is due from none but God; and He is witness over everything.'
ai.seo_question: What is the reward the Prophet asked for in Surah Saba?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Prophet's detachment from worldly gain, affirming that his true reward is divine recognition rather than material compensation. It highlights Allah as the ultimate witness (Shahid) to the sincerity of the message, a concept often linked to the purity (Ismah) of the Ahl al-Bayt who embody this selfless devotion.
